findings.title: Unpickling untrusted data (deserialization risk)
findings.fixPrompt:
Fix one warning security issue that DeployReady found in this project.

Where: app.py:9
Issue: Unpickling untrusted data (deserialization risk) (CWE-502, A08:2025)
What to change: Never unpickle untrusted data — it can execute code. Use JSON or a signed/safe format.

Keep the fix minimal: change only what this issue needs, do not change behaviour or refactor unrelated code, and never put real secrets in code or in your reply (use environment variables).
To confirm: re-run `npx deployready@latest analyze` and check this issue is gone, or call the DeployReady MCP `verify` tool with id "ce5cc49e9723".
